parties.respondent_defendant: Opposite party Nos. 6 and 7 (mother and children)

facts_of_case: Parties approached Family Court, Cuttack in Civil Proceeding No. 254 of 2015 for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Children were rescued by police without court order. Petitioner sought habeas corpus to recover children from custody of opposite party Nos. 6 and 7.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish that the custody of children is being denied.
legal_principles.held: Since they have appeared in person, Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44484954/

legal_principles.principle: A natural guardian has the right to custody of their children.
legal_principles.held: Opposite party No.7 is the mother and natural guardian of those two children.

outcome.final_order: Children are with their natural guardian, application for habeas corpus not maintainable. Petitioner can approach appropriate forum for visiting right/custody of children.

keywords: Latin maxim: 'Nemo dat quod non habet'
use_for_drafting: representing clients in habeas corpus proceedings
